decisions.rationale: Round tower 9 m across: a battered plinth, a tapering body with arrow slits and a string course, a corbelled crenellated parapet at 21 m and a conical slate roof to 30.7 m; 568 triangles, 49,360 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the round collider below 3 m (world-v3-castles: circle footprint test); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: A 20-sided body: the facets show at the closest camera.
Closed shell: no door, interior or reachable parapet.
Masonry is the castle surface layer tiled every 3 m and the moss layer every 2 m; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decal per piece.

decisions.rationale: In the Royal Citadel (seven towers), the Old Fort's ring and the Tide Observatory, at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss, with shadows on the level castle ground. The sightline cutaway shows the hero through it (castle browser suite: 100% of hero pixels visible behind a citadel curtain with the cutaway, 0.4% without), and a camera inside its bounds plus 2 m hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Castles and ruins are scenery: no doors open, no interiors and no reachable walls or towers.
